scope: Primary sources actually used; no third-party PDF redistributed. Source reading and certificate replay do not amount to formal verification or an exhaustive priority assessment.

sources.title: One of beta(4), beta(6), ..., beta(36) is irrational
sources.read_scope: Sections 2--6: kernel, Lemma 4.3 and proof of Corollary 4.4, Lemma 4.6, Corollary 5.9 and Propositions 6.4--6.5. Quantitative estimates used; exact certificates independently reproduced. Lean project not rebuilt.

sources.title: Irrational even beta values in shifted intervals
sources.read_scope: Theorem 1.2, Section 8.2 endpoint table, Proposition B.1, and Section 6 prime dilation. Dilation strategy adapted and rederived for the present kernel.

sources.title: Irrationalite d'au moins un des neuf nombres zeta(5),zeta(7),...,zeta(21)
sources.read_scope: Section 2, Lemma 1 and its construction: differentiation removes the lowest odd zeta value. Method attribution; not an imported quantitative estimate.

sources.title: Many $p$-adic odd zeta values are irrational
sources.read_scope: Lemma 2.3 and proof: Archimedean auxiliary-prime criterion. Method attribution; the manuscript gives the required nonvanishing argument.

sources.title: Arithmetic of Catalan's constant and its relatives
sources.read_scope: Proof of Lemma 1: zeros through the pole region control rational constants. Method attribution; precise arithmetic estimates are taken from Krisman.

sources.title: On the Zudilin-Rivoal Theorem (Russian original)
sources.read_scope: Theorem S in the Russian original: sufficiently large odd m and even h>100m log m. Historical statement comparison; no full independent proof audit.
